name: Ibus
tagline: Java tool for encoding files as images for photo storage
description: A Java-based CLI utility that encodes files into ARGB pixels of PNG images and decodes them back to their original state. This archived experiment represented files as images to use photo cloud storage as a backup destination, including via former Google Photos features that no longer work.
purpose: To bypass file-hosting limitations on cloud providers by translating binary files and directory structures into image files.
strengths: Translates arbitrary files into standard PNG images (up to 64MB per image)
Supports optional 128-bit AES encryption/decryption for data security
Restores original directory structures and file modification timestamps (since v2.1)
Splits large files automatically across multiple image sequences
limitations: The former Google Photos storage features this experiment relied on no longer work; provider API restrictions also limit automated integration
Losing the AES key results in permanent data loss
installation:
git clone git@gitlab.com:christianbrinkmann/ibus.git
cd ibus
# Use pre-built jar in download/ or build it from src/
usage:
# Encode/Decode data with AES key:
java -jar Ibus.jar dataDir --key=YOUR_SECRET_KEY

# Configure size constraints:
java -jar Ibus.jar dataDir --key=YOUR_KEY --minsize=256 --maxsize=4000
